claims.text: As-cast HfMoTaTiZr has a room-temperature yield strength of approximately 1600 MPa.
As-cast HfMoTaTiZr has a yield strength of approximately 855 MPa at about 1000 °C.
As-cast HfMoTaTiZr has a density of 10.21 g/cm³.
Partial substitution of Hf by V will reduce the density of HfMoTaTiZr.
Partial substitution of Hf by V will preserve the alloy's room-temperature yield strength.
Partial substitution of Hf by V will preserve the alloy's yield strength at approximately 1000 °C.
Partial substitution of Hf by V will preserve room- and high-temperature ductility.
Replacing Hf with lighter V atoms lowers the alloy's average atomic mass.
The decrease in average atomic mass caused by V substitution will decrease the alloy's density.
V substitution will maintain lattice distortion and solid-solution strengthening in HfMoTaTiZr.
The V-modified alloys will retain a favorable valence electron concentration and refractory characteristics.
Retained valence electron concentration, refractory characteristics, and lattice distortion will preserve strong bonding and solid-solution strengthening.
Preserved strong bonding and solid-solution strengthening will support yield strength at room temperature and approximately 1000 °C.
At least one Hf(1-x)VxMoTaTiZr composition with 0 < x ≤ 0.3 will reduce density by at least 5% relative to the as-cast baseline.
The V-modified alloys will maintain yield strengths near 1600 MPa at room temperature and 855 MPa at approximately 1000 °C.
V substitution will have minimal effects on ductility and fracture toughness.
The proposed substitution range is Hf(1-x)VxMoTaTiZr with x from 0.05 to 0.30 in the experiment.
Mechanical performance will be evaluated at room temperature and approximately 1000 °C under uniaxial loading.

contradictions.description: A 5% reduction from 10.21 g/cm³ requires a density of at most about 9.70 g/cm³, whereas the stated target of merely being below approximately 10 g/cm³ corresponds to only about a 2.1% reduction and therefore is not equivalent to the 5% criterion.
